feature: A picture saved with a looping motion, opened at Next defaults
summary: Checked what a person at Next defaults sees when they open a picture saved with a looping turn. The shape swings on the canvas, plays again after Space, and the timing strip's repeats label stays readable. Nothing needed fixing; a walk now guards it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/a-saved-looping-turn-plays-at-defaults-walk.json

try.do: Open a picture saved with a looping Rotation (the walk uses fixtures/pivot-of-its-own.photonz) and click the bell.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Space: the swing stops and the bell is back as drawn.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Space again: the bell swings on the canvas, not only in the strip.
Open a glyph saved with a loop inside a 512 icon frame, click it, press Space twice: the glyph and the Actual sizes card both swing.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open a lone ring saved spinning 0 to 360 for ever over 800 ms and look at the strip's ruler at 800.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Compare the label on an 800 ms turn with the bell's 900 ms lap that ends between ticks.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Does the bell swing on the canvas every time you press Space, not only the first time?
Is the repeats label readable next to the 800 on the spinner's ruler?
Does the glyph in the icon frame swing with its Actual sizes previews?
rough: The canvas standing still on a second play still happens, but only with the picture keys switch turned off in Experiments. A person at Next defaults never sees it, so it was not worked on, as this task's checklist asks.
No mock covers how a picture saved with a looping motion opens once Add Motion is gone; it opens with the older Motion section and timing strip, which is what is shown here.
These pictures were taken with the window behind another app, so picked controls show their background look.
